states_from_plan.EFFECTIVE: c > b AND p < 0.05 -> may state: B (resample) accepted more than A (none) on this batch (n=170 pairs, 34 tasks x 5 reps), the same real-signal row as v4 (n=102, p=0.0414) re-measured at higher power. May NOT state 'proves better' (one batch, one model, H-12). Quotable only with n=170 pairs and scorer=false.
states_from_plan.CONTRADICTS: b > c AND p < 0.05 -> no effect claim in EITHER direction; investigate. 'the loop is harmful' is NOT a pre-registered conclusion (R532 AMEND1 direction guard: a significant result in the opposite direction has no pre-registered state and draws no harm conclusion). 不寫「有害」結論。
states_from_plan.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (including c > b with p >= 0.05, or b > c with p >= 0.05) -> record direction and magnitude only; a null here is not a negative result. If v4 was a borderline fluke this is the honest landing; if the effect is real but smaller than v4's point estimate, this is also the honest landing.
states_from_plan.INCOMPLETE: 完成 rep 數 < 5：可自已完成格續跑（runner 跳過已完成格，續跑是基礎設施不是改設計；**不可中途改設計**）；決定狀態只在 5 rep 齊後判定。若批次無法完成（model slot 掛掉、磁碟等），已完成 rep 只描述性報告、不給決定狀態；partial batch is neither clean nor dirty.

caveats: single model, single slot, 34 tasks: does not transfer to another model/harness/budget/corpus without re-running (H-12)

the model channel is a single slot shared with the loop harness; wall times are not a metric and long model calls serialize (v4/v5 observed 14-17s/cell; 5 reps x 68 cells may span several rounds — the INCOMPLETE/resume rule above governs)
max_tokens=4096 per attempt: a truncated answer is a refused delivery, counted in the denominator (a refusal is a failure, not dropped)
this is the SAME row as v4, not a new mechanism: v6 exists only to raise power on the borderline v4 result, not to test a new claim
